# Rosalind Problem: Overlap Graphs (Assembly Solution)

## Problem Description
Given a collection of DNA strings, construct a directed graph where each string is a node, and there's a directed edge from string A to string B if the suffix of A (of length k) matches the prefix of B (of length k).

## Assembly Implementation

```assembly
; Overlap Graphs - Rosalind Problem Solution
; Assembly code for constructing overlap graph from DNA sequences

.section .data
    ; Input data - DNA sequences
    seq1:   .ascii "Rosalind_0498"
    seq2:   .ascii "Rosalind_0500"
    seq3:   .ascii "Rosalind_0501"
    seq4:   .ascii "Rosalind_0502"
    
    ; DNA sequences with actual content
    dna1:   .ascii "
